A '''charred potato''' is a [[potato]] burnt in a [[mud kiln]]. It heals only {{Hp|1}}, compared with {{Hp|5}} for a [[baked potato]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/kiln/charred_potato.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Kilning ===
{{Recipes}}
A potato becomes a charred potato in a mud kiln in 5 seconds.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a charred potato takes 1.6 seconds and heals {{Hp|1}}.
